BiblicalUsage: Issachar = "there is recompense"; n pr m; 1) the 9th son of Jacob and the 5th by Leah his first wife and the progenitor of a tribe by his name; 2) a Korahite Levite and the 7th son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper to the temple; n pr coll; 3) the tribe descended from Issachar the son of Jacob; n pr loc; 4) the territory allocated to the descendants of Issachar when they entered the land of Canaan
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
